utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Ira, what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m heading out now to grab the supplies, then I’ll swing by the hall to drop them off. If you hear anything else needed, let me know and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—thanks. Do you want me to check if we still need tape or spare screws?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. What do you need first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks, Gus. I think we’ll need the drill first, if you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got the drill — I can drop it off whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up nicely—folks are bringing in all sorts of things that need fixing. I’ll let you know if I hear any new details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear, thanks. I’m just trying to figure out the drop-off timing and whether I need to label anything first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard the exact drop-off hours yet, but I’ll ask around. If I find out about labels, I’ll pass it right along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive — what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you bring the spare extension cords and help set up the drop-off table by the community center?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring the spare extension cords and help set up the drop-off table at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli — the repair drive is on my radar. I’m happy to spread the word and invite a few more neighbors if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’d appreciate that a lot — even a little extra help would mean a lot right now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let a few neighbors know right away and nudge them to stop by if they can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — I’m ready to help organize the repair drive. What do you need from me first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — can you start a quick list of broken items and who can help fix each one?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll start a quick list of broken items and match each one with a neighbor who can help fix it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what’s being repaired and when the drive is happening?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not totally sure on the full list yet, but I know the repair drive is coming up soon. I can check and get you the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, please do—I’d rather have the exact details before I help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive. What timing are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a huge help—thank you. I’m thinking Saturday morning, if that works around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning should work for me—I’ll check the school schedule and see what we can safely fit in. Do you want me to help line up any volunteers too?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I just heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming along nicely — we’ve got a few volunteers lined up and I’m just trying to pull the last details together. If you want, I can fill you in on what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules — I’d love a quick rundown of what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still able to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still in — what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Just confirm what kind of items you want people to bring, and whether you need me to help set anything up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, mostly tools, screws, and any spare paint if folks have it. And yes, if you can help set up the tables, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can help set up the tables, and I’ll tell people to bring tools, screws, and any spare paint.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be a huge help, Vik — thank you. I’ll keep track of the supplies and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan around the block and make sure people know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any new updates yet, but I can ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check in with a few people and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to help with that. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I think we still need to sort the tools and set up a few workstations. I’ll check back with everyone and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I can help sort the tools and set up a workstation. Just point me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m probably a bit behind, but what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: If you can, just grab a few tools or drop off any spare parts you’ve got. I’ll sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: No problem — if I hear anything, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure — we need to sort the tools, check the broken items, and label anything that’s beyond repair.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me, Gus. Let’s sort the tools first, then we can work through the broken items one by one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds like a plan, Eli. I’ll bring the tool bins and we can start sorting now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can do that — I’ve got a couple of spare tools I can bring by later. Just remind me where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Quinn — you can drop them off at my porch anytime after 5, and I’ll make sure they get sorted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—want me to spread the word or coordinate anyone specific?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I still need help finding volunteers who can do pickups and small home repairs, plus a few drop-off locations for supplies.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Please spread the word, and if you can, coordinate anyone who needs help with tools or a ride.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. Let me know what you need first, and I’ll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’ll check our supplies and make a quick list of what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — send me the missing list, and I’ll line up the rest and share an update with the block.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I just heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m checking the signup list now. Do you know if we still need more volunteers or just supplies?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure—I only caught part of it. I can ask around and see whether they need more hands or just a few extra supplies.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help me make a quick list of the items we still need and who can drop them off after school?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can make a quick list and see who can drop things off after school.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you confirm what time the repair drive starts and whether you’re bringing the tools or just helping load things?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m not sure of the start time yet, but I can check. I’m happy to help load things, and I can bring the tools if you want.
